subject.title: feat(skills): publish large bundles via staged upload

question: Should this PR be allowed to add the staged skill upload API once it has a staged-bundle size/expansion guard and real large-bundle publish proof?
rationale: The implementation direction matches the package staged-upload precedent, but it creates a new public upload path whose operational behavior and wire protocol need maintainer acceptance after the concrete blocker is fixed.

options.title: Fix and review for merge
options.body: Require the staged-bundle guard, remove the changelog entry, and ask for redacted real publish proof before considering merge.

options.title: Pause API surface
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want to add the skill upload-ticket route yet.

recommendation.title: Fix and review for merge
recommendation.body: Require the staged-bundle guard, remove the changelog entry, and ask for redacted real publish proof before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the requested reviewer and recently worked on the publish/prepublication pipeline touched by this PR.
